cssPair.equalHashesDisposition: Eligible for arm comparison only after both per-arm bindings and all other diagnostic prerequisites are received.
cssPair.differentHashesDisposition: CONFOUNDED unless the independent equivalence review below establishes the relevant CSS equivalence.

armBinding.retainedFulfilledBody: trace.fontIngress.css.apiBody: path, bytes and sha256 of the exact unmodified CSS supplied to fulfillment.
armBinding.originalLinkRequest: trace.fontIngress.css.requestId: the actual original-link native Request identity.
armBinding.originalLinkResponse: trace.fontIngress.css.responseId: the actual native Response associated with that Request.
armBinding.fulfillment: trace.fontIngress.css.fulfillment must be fulfilled only after successful fulfill(response=api_response) without status, header or body overrides.
armBinding.nativeTerminal: trace.fontIngress.css.nativeTerminal must be finished for that same original-link Request, with valid native status/MIME and no redirect or failure.
armBinding.trustedApplication: Named observation receipts must bind the trusted original-link load to the exact connected authored link, its current media=all application and relevant registered faces. A capture receipt with mediaAtDispatch=print may be valid when the current link is all.
armBinding.hashBinding: deliveredCssSha256 must equal apiBody.sha256 and may be accepted only after the actual native Request/Response/finished receipt, successful unmodified fulfillment and trusted load/current application are all bound.

nativeBody.capturedRule: Retain the separately captured native CSS hash and require it to equal deliveredCssSha256 and apiBody.sha256.
nativeBody.unavailableRule: Retain status=unavailable and the actual reason. Explicitly assess the fulfilled-byte/native-transaction binding with this limitation; do not claim independent native-body capture or treat an intended URL plus API body as sufficient.

independentEquivalence.rule: A separate explicit independent review must establish equivalence and retain its disposition against both bodies/hashes/native receipts. URL equality, user-agent equality, equal face counts or an assumed provider response cannot establish it.

cssPair.fontDemandRule: Arm-dependent font demand and body differences are intended evidence. Do not require the fallback arm to request or download unused optional faces.

comparisonRequirements.nativeEvidenceRule: Review the complete original early native video and require an actually readable pre-ingress card, realized CSS application and font request-ingress delay, all required native terminals/body custody, post-tail finalization and successful cleanup. Source values alone do not establish pixels or diagnostic receipt validity.
